description: France has experienced significant unrest following protests over rising living costs and public services, resulting in violence and property damage. More than 2,400 people were arrested nationwide as rioters targeted shops, city halls, and public offices. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu instructed local authorities to consider curfews to prevent further violence while reviewing policing policies.

description: A stampede at the Chorbagan Sarbajanin Durga Puja pandal in north Kolkata, West Bengal, killed 19 people, including four children. Seven people, including two committee office-bearers, have been arrested. Kolkata Police have registered a culpable homicide case as the State government announces compensation and introduces stricter crowd management measures at Durga Puja pandals.

title: Rare Mughal portrait book sold for £16,640, nearly 21 times estimate

This remarkable volume, which presents visual interpretations of royal figures, was anticipated to bring in £500 to £800 but astonishingly fetched £16,640. This highlights the growing interest in India's royal history, despite some issues regarding the book's condition.

This agreement allows India to export goods to New Zealand without tariffs, boosting several sectors. India aims to double bilateral trade with New Zealand to NZD 7 billion by 2030. New Zealand exported nearly NZ$2.03 billion worth of goods and services to India in 2025.

title: ‘No proof found’: UK to Bhopal family seeking repayment of 1917 war loan
description: UK’s Debt Management Office says it found no evidence that a 1917 Indian War Loan, in which a Bhopal merchant invested Rs 35,000, was ever a British government obligation. A Sehore family holding the century-old certificate seeks an account of repayment, estimating its value at several crores today. The DMO didn’t say whether it was repaid.

The attack also resulted in over two dozen troops wounded, according to military officials. Following the strikes, Yemeni forces reported recapturing territory in Taiz governorate, while Houthi forces continued their offensive. In another incident, a coalition airstrike killed nine people, including children and women, in Saada.

After being lost for nearly 69 years, it is expected to fetch between $946,000 and $1.33 million. The tiara was once a wedding gift in 1864 to Marie Isabelle, an Orléanist claimant.

She became the first woman Indian Army officer to serve as Aide-de-Camp (ADC) to Uttar Pradesh Governor Anandiben Patel on September 14, 2025, marking a milestone for women in uniform.

Tusk will also meet with business stakeholders in Bengaluru and participate in business forums.

title: Mississippi woman keeps $1.2m farm bought in 1994 as ex loses court appeal

The Mississippi Court of Appeals upheld the lower court's ruling classifying the farm as non-marital property, given its purchase before their marriage. Wiley challenged the ruling, claiming marital asset status due to financial connections and alleged contributions. Courts evaluated the evidence and determined that such claims did not prove ownership.

description: Studies reveal that the way time is articulated can alter individual perceptions of its length and commitment. For example, the phrase 'two hours and 55 minutes' conveys a sense of extended duration compared to 'three hours', even though it's shorter. This variation in perception plays a crucial role in how we approach goal setting and notice deadlines, indicating that modifying our time expressions could greatly influence our daily choices.

In response, officers escorted the bus to its destination, ensuring the safety of all travelers.
